title: Tellers
rationale: Processing deposits, withdrawals, and account inquiries are routine transactions increasingly handled by ATMs and digital banking. Remaining tellers handle complex transactions and in-person customer service, but the role shrinks dramatically.

title: Top executives
rationale: AI provides comprehensive analytics, report generation, and decision support. However, organizational leadership, stakeholder management, strategic vision, board relations, and navigating complex human dynamics are deeply human executive functions.

title: Tour and travel guides
rationale: Leading tours, providing live commentary, and managing group logistics in physical locations are interpersonal and embodied duties. AI-powered audio guides substitute in some contexts, but human guides retain value for interactive experiences.

title: Training and development managers
rationale: AI generates training content, conducts needs assessments, and tracks learning outcomes. Managers retain strategic workforce development planning, organizational change facilitation, and leadership development roles.

title: Training and development specialists
rationale: AI creates training materials, e-learning modules, and assessments autonomously. Human specialists focus on facilitation, executive coaching, and designing programs for complex organizational change.

title: Transportation, storage, and distribution managers
rationale: Route optimization, inventory management, and logistics analytics are heavily automated by AI. Managers retain strategic planning, vendor relationships, and managing physical warehouse and transportation operations.

title: Travel agents
rationale: Itinerary planning, booking, price comparison, and travel documentation are digital tasks AI handles autonomously. Human agents retain value for complex multi-destination trips, luxury travel consulting, and handling disruptions, but routine bookings are automated.

title: Tutors
rationale: AI tutoring systems deliver personalized instruction, practice problems, and explanations effectively by 2031. Human tutors retain value for motivational coaching, complex conceptual breakthroughs, and test preparation for high-stakes exams.

title: Umpires, referees, and other sports officials
rationale: Officiating sporting events requires physical presence, real-time judgment, and game management. AI aids with video review and rule enforcement, but human officials remain essential for live competition.

title: Urban and regional planners
rationale: Data analysis, GIS mapping, zoning review, and report writing are digital tasks AI handles well. Planners retain community engagement, public hearing facilitation, and complex policy balancing roles, but analytical productivity increases dramatically.

title: Veterinarians
rationale: Examining animals, performing surgeries, and administering treatments are hands-on clinical tasks. AI aids with diagnostics, treatment protocols, and records, but physical veterinary medicine requires human skill and judgment.

title: Veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers
rationale: Feeding, cleaning, restraining, and caring for animals are entirely physical tasks. AI has negligible impact on these hands-on animal care duties.

title: Veterinary technologists and technicians
rationale: Assisting with animal procedures, collecting samples, administering medications, and providing animal care are hands-on clinical tasks. AI assists with records and lab analysis, but physical work dominates.

title: Waiters and waitresses
rationale: Taking orders, serving food, and attending to diners are physical and interpersonal tasks. AI ordering systems exist, but human table service remains the standard in most restaurants.

title: Water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators
rationale: Operating treatment equipment, monitoring chemical processes, and maintaining physical systems are hands-on tasks. AI aids with process monitoring and optimization, but physical plant operations require human operators.

title: Water transportation workers
rationale: Operating vessels, managing cargo, and navigating waterways are physical tasks. AI aids with navigation and logistics planning, but hands-on ship operation and safety management remain human.

title: Web developers and digital designers
rationale: AI agents build, deploy, and maintain standard websites and web applications autonomously by 2031. Human developers focus on complex interactive applications, novel UX challenges, and system architecture, but routine web development is largely automated.

title: Welders, cutters, solderers, and brazers
rationale: Joining and cutting metals using welding equipment is hands-on skilled trade work. Robotic welding expands in factories, but field welding and custom fabrication remain human tasks.

title: Wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives
rationale: Product information, pricing analysis, order processing, and client communication are digital tasks AI handles efficiently. Human reps retain value in relationship-driven B2B sales, complex negotiations, and key account management.

title: Wind turbine technicians
rationale: Climbing turbines, inspecting components, and performing repairs at height are physical, hazardous tasks. AI aids with predictive maintenance scheduling, but hands-on repair remains entirely human.

title: Woodworkers
rationale: Cutting, shaping, and assembling wood products using hand and power tools is physical skilled work. CNC programming aids some production, but manual woodworking remains human.

title: Writers and authors
rationale: AI generates articles, marketing copy, reports, and even creative fiction by 2031. Human writers retain value for literary voice, investigative journalism, and deeply personal creative work, but commercial content production is heavily automated.

title: Zoologists and wildlife biologists
rationale: AI assists with data analysis, species identification, and literature review. However, fieldwork—observing wildlife, collecting specimens, and conducting ecological surveys in natural habitats—requires physical human presence.
